Notice | Massachusetts Cannabis Control Commission Public Health and Safety Advisory: Contaminated and Potentially Contaminated Marijuana Products | February 3, 2025

The Commission identified 544 lab samples that previously failed Total Yeast and Mold testing, noted in the Summary Suspension Order issued on June 30, 2025, for products tested between April 1, 2024 and April 15, 2025.

Consumers and Patients that possess any of the affected products may destroy them or return them to the licensee where they were purchased.
